title: Income Tax Act
register: Legislation of the Northwest Territories (Legislation Division, Department of Justice, GNWT)

version.how_known: 'Modified Date' of the file on the register's A-Z listing, read 2026-10-20 (UTC 2026-10-19T17:17:48Z), and the HTTP Last-Modified header of the PDF
version.as_at_note: The cover page of the consolidation lists the amending instruments, with in-force dates where the register gives them; the text is the law as consolidated on the consolidation date. The register says its consolidations are updated monthly and may not be the most current version.

conversion.method: pdfplumber 0.11 word geometry (scripts nwt_convert.py, nwt_tables.py, nwt_post.py in the session scratchpad): bilingual pages split at the gutter (x = 313 pt) and the English column kept; running heads, page numbers and printer lines removed; English marginal notes (older consolidations) emitted as a heading line before the provision; lines rejoined into paragraphs at section, subsection, paragraph and definition labels; minus signs drawn as short rules (not glyphs) restored as "-"; line-end hyphens dropped inside words.

editorial_restorations.what: a list of subsection references split at a page break (wrongly read as a new subsection) rejoined
a list of quoted terms split over two lines (wrongly read as a new definition) rejoined
stray space after a hyphen in the source line break
s.3.2(2): stacked fraction (A - B)(C + D) over (E - B) written inline; the fraction bar spans (A - B)(C + D) only
s.3.2(2.1): stacked fraction (A + B) over 2 written inline
s.1(7)(h): the two-column substitution table rebuilt by hand from the PDF layout as rows

conversion.checked: Read through after conversion against pdftotext -layout output of the same PDF.
